# Reference index

This folder holds the deeper implementation details for the combined scaffold. The top-level skill stays concise and uses progressive disclosure to surface only the relevant workflow.

## Files

- [rest.md](rest.md): Minimal API workflow for REST projects
- [grpc.md](grpc.md): gRPC workflow for gRPC projects

## Selection rules

- REST projects should use the Minimal API pattern.
- gRPC projects should use the gRPC pattern.
- Only reveal the chosen file when the user has selected that stack.
